headline: Kano Free Trade Zone Records 87 Firms, N40bn Customs Revenue
summary: The Kano Free Trade Zone has reported that 87 operational enterprises are driving manufacturing and foreign investment, while customs revenue generated within the industrial estate rose to N40 billion as of August 2026.
why: Free trade zone performance metrics reflect regional manufacturing output, export volumes, and industrial employment generation.

impacts.why: 87 firms drive exports and customs revenue rises to N40 billion.
